requirements.text: Password authentication is exposed as POST /api/collections/{collection}/auth-with-password.
For a non-superuser, a non-empty ListRule is applied to the record-list query; a matching authenticated record can receive HTTP 200 list results.
For a non-superuser, a non-empty ListRule filters out nonmatching records while the list response remains HTTP 200.
For a non-superuser, a non-empty ViewRule is added to the record lookup; a record not found through that lookup produces HTTP 404.
For a non-superuser, a non-empty CreateRule that does not match rejects record creation with HTTP 400.
For a non-superuser, a non-empty UpdateRule is added to the record lookup; a record not found through that lookup produces HTTP 404.
For a non-superuser, a non-empty DeleteRule is added to the record lookup; a record not found through that lookup produces HTTP 404.
A permitted record creation returns HTTP 200.
A permitted record update returns HTTP 200.
A permitted record deletion returns HTTP 204.
